关键词: Amendment to Employment Agreement with Mark S. Thompson
主要内容: On November 18, 2015, Fairchild Semiconductor International, Inc. entered into a merger agreement with ON Semiconductor Corporation and Falcon Operations Sub, Inc. Acquisition Sub will initiate a tender offer to acquire all FCSH shares at $20.00 per share. Following the offer, Acquisition Sub will merge with FCSH, with FCSH as a subsidiary of ON. All shares, options, RSUs, PUs, and DSUs will convert to cash based on merger consideration. The merger requires shareholder approval, antitrust approvals, and legal clearance. Both boards approved the agreement and recommended shareholder approval. The agreement includes termination rights and fees: ON may receive $72 million if the agreement is terminated due to a superior proposal or board change. FCSH may trigger this fee if it completes a competing proposal. In cases of antitrust issues or financing failure, ON may pay $180 million or $21.5 million. The company also adopted a change-in-control severance plan to protect executives, including named executives other than Mr. Thompson, with provisions for severance, prorated incentives, and COBRA coverage. The plan aligns with Mr. Thompson’s employment agreement amendments, as detailed in Exhibits 10.1 and 10.2 of the filing.
